name: Mizuki Haruna
source:
A one year younger student who is studying at Kirameki High School. She calls herself a nickname 'Haru' in her diary and wants someone to share the feelings with, until the protagonist suddenly finds her diary and decides to exchange a diary every month. She works in a sweet shop everyday and has a dream to be a pâtissière.

Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_4]Wikipedia[/url]
